mapper.select: select i.id, i.ticket_id, i.visit_date, i.timeslot_id, t.name as timeslot_name, i.total_qty, i.sold_qty, i.locked_qty, i.status from ticket_inventory i join timeslot t on i.timeslot_id=t.id where i.ticket_id=#{ticketId} and i.visit_date=( select max(i2.visit_date) from ticket_inventory i2 where i2.ticket_id=i.ticket_id and i2.timeslot_id=i.timeslot_id )

select i.id, i.ticket_id, i.visit_date, i.timeslot_id, t.name as timeslot_name, i.total_qty, i.sold_qty, i.locked_qty, i.status from ticket_inventory i join timeslot t on i.timeslot_id=t.id where i.ticket_id=#{ticketId} and i.visit_date>=#{startDate} and i.status=1 and (i.total_qty - i.sold_qty - i.locked_qty) > 0 order by i.visit_date asc, i.timeslot_id asc

select i.id, i.ticket_id, tk.name as ticket_name, tk.price_cent as ticket_price_cent, tk.morning_enabled as ticket_morning_enabled, tk.afternoon_enabled as ticket_afternoon_enabled, tk.valid_date as ticket_valid_date, i.visit_date, i.timeslot_id, ts.name as timeslot_name, i.total_qty, i.sold_qty, i.locked_qty, i.status from ticket_inventory i join timeslot ts on i.timeslot_id=ts.id join ticket tk on i.ticket_id=tk.id where tk.scenic_id=#{scenicId} and tk.price_cent=#{priceCent} and tk.status=1 and i.visit_date>=#{startDate} and i.status=1 and (i.total_qty - i.sold_qty - i.locked_qty) > 0 order by tk.id asc, i.visit_date asc, i.timeslot_id asc
select * from ticket_inventory where ticket_id=#{ticketId} and visit_date=#{visitDate} and timeslot_id=#{timeslotId} for update
select * from ticket_inventory where ticket_id=#{ticketId} and visit_date=#{visitDate} and timeslot_id=#{timeslotId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ticket_inventory(ticket_id, visit_date, timeslot_id, total_qty, sold_qty, locked_qty, status) values(#{ticketId}, #{visitDate}, #{timeslotId}, #{totalQty}, 0, 0, 1)
mapper.update: update ticket_inventory set total_qty=GREATEST(0, total_qty + #{delta}), updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
update ticket_inventory set locked_qty=locked_qty + #{qty}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
update ticket_inventory set locked_qty=GREATEST(0, locked_qty - #{qty}), updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
update ticket_inventory set locked_qty=locked_qty - #{qty}, sold_qty=sold_qty + #{qty}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}

update ticket_inventory set locked_qty=locked_qty - #{qty}, sold_qty=sold_qty + #{qty}, updated_at=now() where ticket_id=#{ticketId} and visit_date=#{visitDate} and timeslot_id=#{timeslotId} and locked_qty >= #{qty}
update ticket_inventory set locked_qty=locked_qty - #{qty}, updated_at=now() where ticket_id=#{ticketId} and visit_date=#{visitDate} and timeslot_id=#{timeslotId} and locked_qty >= #{qty}
update ticket_inventory set sold_qty=sold_qty + #{qty}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
update ticket_inventory set sold_qty=GREATEST(0, sold_qty - #{qty}), updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
